name: Discount Status Bar
description: Component that shows the status of any approaching promotions. Only one may be used per page.

attribute_definitions.name: Container class
attribute_definitions.description: Class(es) to add to this component's container for spacing, alignment, etc.

attribute_definitions.name: Campaign ID
attribute_definitions.description: For best results, group the promotions you want to appear in this component under a common campaign, and enter the campaign ID here to limit promotions to just that campaign.

attribute_definitions.name: Checkout Button Text
attribute_definitions.description: Optional custom text for the Checkout button.

attribute_definitions.name: Completion Message
attribute_definitions.description: A message to show the user after all promotion thresholds have been met, at which point this will replace the basket total amount.
